raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly disambiguated the entity, assuming “Philip of Sicily” referred to Philip I of Taranto (son of Charles II) despite WebSurfer having already retrieved the correct identification (Philip [1255/56–1277], son of Charles I of Sicily/Naples). The Planner ignored the prior result, did not seek clarification despite ambiguity, and prematurely finalized the task with the wrong father (Charles II instead of Charles I).
